title: 08. Multi-Agent & Patterns: Retriever Metrics
summary: What is a Retriever? > The component that fetches relevant documents from a database given a query. > Example: User asks "What is RAG?" → Retriever finds top 5 matching documents.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
> **What is a Retriever?**
> The component that fetches relevant documents from a database given a query.
> Example: User asks "What is RAG?" → Retriever finds top 5 matching documents.

sections.title: Precision@K
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  PRECISION@K = "Of the top K results I returned,               │
│                how many were ACTUALLY relevant?"                │
│                                                                 │
│  Formula:  Precision@K = Relevant docs in top-K  /  K          │
│                                                                 │
│  EXAMPLE (K=5):                                                 │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │  Rank 1: "What is RAG?"           ✅ Relevant            │  │
│  │  Rank 2: "RAG vs Fine-tuning"     ✅ Relevant            │  │
│  │  Rank 3: "Python tutorial"        ❌ Not Relevant        │  │
│  │  Rank 4: "RAG implementation"     ✅ Relevant            │  │
│  │  Rank 5: "SQL database guide"     ❌ Not Relevant        │  │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│                                                                 │
│  Precision@5 = 3 relevant / 5 total = 0.60                     │
│                                                                 │
│  ✅ Good:  0.80+   (80% of results are relevant)               │
│  ⚠️  OK:   0.60    (60% relevant, some noise)                  │
│  ❌ Bad:   0.40-   (more noise than signal)                     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

sections.title: Recall@K
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  RECALL@K = "Of ALL the relevant docs that exist,              │
│              how many did I find in top K?"                     │
│                                                                 │
│  Formula:  Recall@K = Relevant found in top-K  /  Total relevant│
│                                                                 │
│  EXAMPLE:                                                       │
│  Total relevant docs in DB: 5                                   │
│  Retrieved in top-5:        3                                   │
│                                                                 │
│  Recall@5 = 3 / 5 = 0.60                                       │
│                                                                 │
│  WHY RECALL MATTERS:                                           │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │  Missed relevant doc → LLM doesn't have full context     │  │
│  │  Low recall → Incomplete or wrong answers                │  │
│  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│                                                                 │
│  ✅ Good:  0.80+   ⚠️  OK: 0.60    ❌ Bad: 0.40-              │
│                                                                 │
│  PRECISION vs RECALL TRADEOFF:                                  │
│  Increase K → Recall ↑ but Precision ↓                         │
│  Decrease K → Precision ↑ but Recall ↓                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

sections.title: MRR (Mean Reciprocal Rank)
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  MRR = "How HIGH UP is the FIRST relevant result?"             │
│                                                                 │
│  Formula: MRR = 1 / rank_of_first_relevant_doc                 │
│           Mean across all queries                               │
│                                                                 │
│  EXAMPLE:                                                       │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  Query A: First relevant at rank 1  → 1/1 = 1.000       │   │
│  │  Query B: First relevant at rank 2  → 1/2 = 0.500       │   │
│  │  Query C: First relevant at rank 5  → 1/5 = 0.200       │   │
│  │  Query D: No relevant found         → 1/∞ = 0.000       │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                 │
│  MRR = (1.000 + 0.500 + 0.200 + 0.000) / 4 = 0.425            │
│                                                                 │
│  WHY MRR MATTERS:                                               │
│  Users and LLMs look at TOP results first.                      │
│  A relevant doc at rank 1 is far more valuable than rank 10.    │
│                                                                 │
│  ✅ Good:  0.80+   ⚠️  OK: 0.50    ❌ Bad: 0.30-              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

sections.title: Retriever Metrics Visual Summary
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              RETRIEVER METRICS CHEATSHEET                       │
├──────────────┬──────────────────────────┬───────────────────────┤
│  Metric      │  Question Answered        │  Best When            │
├──────────────┼──────────────────────────┼───────────────────────┤
│ Precision@K  │ "Are results relevant?"   │ Low noise needed      │
│ Recall@K     │ "Did I find all?"         │ Completeness matters  │
│ F1@K         │ "Balance P and R"         │ General use           │
│ MRR          │ "Is #1 result good?"      │ First result critical │
│ NDCG@K       │ "Is ranking quality good?"│ Order matters         │
│ MAP          │ "Good across all queries?"│ Full system eval      │
│ Hit Rate@K   │ "Any hit in top K?"       │ Simple binary check   │
└──────────────┴──────────────────────────┴───────────────────────┘
```
